discourse.title: Follow Divine Commands
discourse.excerpt: There is no point in feeling bad that Swami is not talking to you. Make efforts to attain the deservedness, so that Swami would talk to you. I have taught you on innumerable occasions, but have you made any sincere attempt to practice even one of My teachings? When you do not give up evil tendencies like hatred, jealousy, and pomposity, how do you expect Swami to talk to you?
discourse.theme: Practice His teachings — first deserve, then desire.

reflection: Why does it feel like Swami is silent in my life? Because He has already spoken — volumes of it. The silence you feel is the gap between hearing and doing. Swami's challenge is blunt and loving at once: practice even one of My teachings. Pick a single line of His and live it today — that is how you make Him talk to you.

video.title: 31 - Practice At least One Teaching | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | Nov 23, 1994

seva_nudge: Practice one teaching today: reach out to someone you have friction with and speak only words of love.
